question: Which of the following marine animals has no head, bone, eyes or nose?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Starfish**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Starfish** is a marine animal that belongs to the class Asteroidea.
 
• It has no head, bones, eyes, or nose, making it unique among marine creatures.
 
• Starfish are known for their star-shaped body and their ability to regenerate lost arms.
 
• They have a water vascular system that helps them in locomotion and feeding.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Starfish** are found in all the world's oceans, from the tropics to frigid polar waters.
 
• They play a crucial role in marine ecosystems, often serving as keystone species.
 
• Starfish can have various colors, sizes, and shapes, with some species having more than five arms.
 
• They primarily feed on mollusks, such as clams and oysters, by prying them open with their tube feet.
 
• Their unique biological features make them a subject of interest in marine biology and ecological studies.
